correctness.rationale: Exact signed partition product equals the distinct subset generating product, as verified algebraically from geometric series. All 1024 subsets of the ten-element base are enumerated and independently polynomial-counted, proving all n=65..201 representable and precisely the 17 zeros below 65. For m>=7, the two interval unions overlap because margin T_(m-1)-129-2m² starts at 39 and increases by 2m²-4m-2>0. Therefore all n>=65 are represented. No finite check substitutes for the infinite induction; the standalone checker passed.

originality.rationale: The 2018/2019 Ciolan square-partition study explicitly states the strict-positivity threshold 65 as a belief checked numerically, not a theorem (Remark 4). The 2020/2021 Ciolan general-power paper provides a full positive product but proves only nonnegativity and eventual strict positivity, not exact 65. A complete subset-sum interval propagation and explicit seventeen-zero classification were not found in inspected texts or mathematical finding searches; residual unindexed coverage is possible.
residual_risks: An unindexed earlier solution to the precise sharp cutoff conjecture or a theorem about eventual subset sums of odd squares and twice squares could cover the claim.
